title: Airy Argentinian Chestnut Empanadas
description: These empanadas are a delicious and airy Argentinian dish featuring chestnuts and infused oil, perfect for a date night. The ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients make it a great option for a relaxing evening.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the mashed chestnuts, infused oil, red wine, onion, garlic, thyme, and salt.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the chestnut mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
